name: Algebraic Norm Equivalence
description: Replaces the explicit matrix bilinear form with a mathematically equivalent algebraic condition: the sum of the squares of pairwise additions must equal their sum. Since the variables are binary, this equation holds if and only if no two selected variables share a rule. This forces the model to perform algebraic expansion to discover the underlying mutual exclusion (Independent Set) required for efficient pruning, defeating models that rely on surface-level matrix-to-graph pattern matching.
